title: Skills
markdown:
**What it is:** Reusable how-to procedures the Executive can pull up on demand — checklists, playbooks, and templates for recurring tasks.

**What it does:**

- Browse the skills catalog with each skill's purpose and when to use it.
- Search by keyword to find the right procedure.
- Create your own skills with a name, category, when-to-use, and a Markdown body.
- Update or delete your custom skills (built-in ones are protected).

*Note: skills are indexed so the Executive can discover and apply the right one mid-task.*
